voted_differently_from_majority.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Chapters 4-4, 4-60 and 8-16 by adding new sections regarding cannabinoid hemp product definitions, regulations, health requirements and hemp product offenses involving minors and deletion of Section 4-4-333 in entirety (Vetoed)
Amendment of Municipal Code Titles 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14A, 14B, 14X and 15 (2026 Municipal Code Revenue Ordinance Alternative)
Fiscal Year 2026 Tax Levy, as amended
Settlement agreement regarding case of Nicolas Sintos v. City of Chicago, cited as Case No. 21 C 5327

Amendment of Municipal Code Chapters 4-4, 4-60 and 8-16 by adding new sections regarding cannabinoid hemp product definitions, regulations, health requirements and hemp product offenses involving minors and deletion of Section 4-4-333 in entirety (Vetoed)
Amendment of Municipal Code Sections 8-32-060 and 8-32-120 to replace the term "churches" with "places of worship" regarding designation of and restrictions within noise sensitive zones
Amendment of Municipal Code Section 2-8-040 allowing Alderpersons to propose up to four honorary street designations per calendar year
Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 4-155 by adding new Section 4-155-045 to prohibit issuance of video gaming licenses in 28th Ward
Municipal Code 4-155-045 (new) disallowing the issuance of additional video gaming licenses in Wards 26, 27, 33, 35, 49

Amendment of Municipal Code Section 6-105-030 entitling employers of occupations where gratuities are customary to an allowance for gratuities as part of hourly wage rate not to exceed 24 percent of minimum wage rate

Submission of public question by referendum to Chicago voters at March 17, 2026 primary election on whether Chicago should establish 100-day non-salaried Office of Chicago Reform Commission to reform and improve city government by drafting City charter proposal

Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 2-8 by adding new Section 2-8-036 regarding ordinance requirements for issuance of bonds and other indebtedness including approval by three-fifths affirmative vote of alderpersons for ordinances authorizing debt issuance

Amendment of Municipal Code by adding Section 2-32-385 regarding Ongoing Metered Parking Concession Payments and allocation of Concession Payments among City pension funds (pursuant to Section 2.3 of SO2026-0025407)
